_readme: Calibration sets (COLLECTION.md §4). `membership` is PRO-63's trap set:
22 rows (10 true / 12 false), key material pre-registered in
scratch/trap-key-draft.json BEFORE the base build (2026-09-02), every
answer document-anchored: the site's own data-investor attribute,
Form D accessions from the local bulk zips, or a press citation.
Gate: zero false members at high confidence before verdicts write;
the structural falses must be verified absent from the built base.
The stage golden set is PRO-66's and lands with classification.

Automation Anywhere 2021

lightspeed-microscopy: Namesake Form D filer: LIGHTSPEED MICROSCOPY, INC., Redmond WA (3 filings 2019q1-2021q2), renamed Alpenglow Biosciences — registry external, never a base row
oyster-travel: Pre-tenure officer seat: OYSTER TRAVEL Corp's 2009q3 Form D (0001432009-09-000005) names Justin Caldbeck Director — his Bain Capital Ventures era; he joined Lightspeed only in 2011; no Lightspeed listing or vehicle on any Oyster filing
arrikto: Ex-partner next-firm deal: Arrikto's 2020q3 Form D (0001663618-20-000002) names John Vrionis Director — Unusual Ventures led it; Vrionis left Lightspeed in 2017 to co-found Unusual (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unusual_Ventures); whose money was behind the seat on that date: Unusual's
popupbagels: Founder homonym: PopUpBagels Inc.'s 2024q1 Form D (0002007083-24-000001) names its own founder Adam Goldberg, Executive Officer, Westport CT — a different person from Lightspeed's 2013-2018 Adam Goldberg, who by then ran Standard Crypto (his Standard Crypto fund Form Ds 2019q2+ name him)
